tooltips.supertextConnection: The Supertext connection with the API key. Empty: the first connection of type Supertext, or the SUPERTEXT_API_KEY environment variable.
tooltips.supertextSourceLanguage: The language to translate from. Empty: the main language.
tooltips.supertextTargetLanguages: The languages to translate into. Empty: every other language.
tooltips.supertextOverwrite: Off: fields that already have text in a target language are kept. On: they are replaced by the new translation.
tooltips.supertextPoliteness: Formal or informal form of address, for languages that have both (e.g. Sie/du in German). Supertext doesn't offer it for every language (not e.g. for English, Romansh or Albanian): those are translated with the default tone, and the result says so.
tooltips.supertextFileFormat: Export for translation: XLIFF 1.2 for translation tools (one file for all target languages), or HTML (one target language per file, e.g. for Supertext's web app).

messages.supertextKeyHelp: No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin. Generate your API key at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API; requires the Admin role).
messages.supertextNoApiKey: No Supertext API key is configured.
messages.supertextNoApiKeyConnection: No Supertext API key is configured. Create a connection of type "Supertext" under Administration → Connections.
messages.supertextConnectionNotFound: The Supertext connection {id} was not found.
messages.supertextNeedsRecord: Translate with Supertext runs on a record: use it from a record or from the list (mass action).
messages.supertextNoTextFields: {entity} has no multilingual text fields. Make the fields multilingual and add languages under Administration → Languages.
messages.supertextNotALanguage: "{language}" is not one of the languages of this record ({languages}).
messages.supertextUnreachable: The Supertext service could not be reached.
messages.supertextAuthFailed: Authentication failed. Please check the Supertext API key.
messages.supertextInvalidLanguagePair: Supertext does not support this language pair ({source} → {target}). Check the language mapping of the Supertext connection.
messages.supertextNotFound: The requested Supertext resource was not found.
messages.supertextTooLarge: The content is too large for Supertext to translate in one go.
messages.supertextRateLimited: Too many requests to Supertext. Please try again shortly.
messages.supertextUnavailable: The Supertext service is currently unavailable.
messages.supertextNoFileId: Supertext did not return a file id.
messages.supertextFailed: Supertext could not translate the document.
messages.supertextLimitExceeded: Your Supertext translation limit is exceeded. Please upgrade your subscription.
messages.supertextDeleted: The document was deleted at Supertext before it could be downloaded.
messages.supertextTimeout: Timed out waiting for the Supertext translation.
messages.supertextTooLong: The translation is longer than the field allows: {fields}.
messages.supertextPartlyTooLong: Not translated because the translation is too long: {fields}.
messages.supertextRejected: AtroPIM did not accept the translation: {reason}
messages.supertextNoTargets: No other languages to translate into.
messages.supertextRecordsFailed: The Executions panel of the action shows why.
messages.supertextUnsupportedLanguage: The language {language} has no Supertext language yet. Ask your administrator to map it in the language mapping of the Supertext connection (Administration → Connections), e.g. "de_DE = de-CH".
messages.supertextUnsupportedFeature: Supertext offers no formal or informal tone for this language. Set the action's form of address to Default.
messages.supertextPolitenessSkipped: Supertext offers no formal or informal tone for {language}: translated with the default tone.
messages.supertextKeyCheckOk: API key checked: the connection to Supertext works.
messages.supertextKeyCheckInvalid: Supertext rejected the API key. Check that you copied the whole key, or generate a new one at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API; requires the Admin role). No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin.
messages.supertextKeyCheckMissing: No API key is set yet. No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin. Generate your API key at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API; requires the Admin role).
messages.supertextKeyCheckUnreachable: The API key couldn't be checked because Supertext can't be reached. The settings are saved; check again later.
messages.supertextKeyCheckError: The API key couldn't be checked: Supertext answered with an error ({status}). The settings are saved; check again later.
messages.supertextKeyCheckNone: Not checked yet: save the connection or click Test connection.
messages.supertextReportsOn: Version information is sent to Supertext. Ping URL for the Supertext Commando Center: {url}
messages.supertextReportsOff: Version information is not sent to Supertext.
messages.supertextReportsOffEnvironment: Version information is not sent to Supertext: SUPERTEXT_VERSION_REPORTS=0 is set on the server and overrides this setting.
messages.supertextLanguageNotMapped: {language}: not mapped. Add a line "{language} = …" with its Supertext code to the language mapping; until then it isn't translated.
messages.supertextLanguageUnlisted: (not in Supertext's list of October 2026: sent as entered)
messages.supertextHtmlOneLanguage: An HTML file holds one target language: choose exactly one target language, or use XLIFF.
messages.supertextFileImportOpens: Import translation opens in a new tab.
messages.supertextFileInvalidFile: This file isn't a valid XLIFF or HTML translation file.
messages.supertextFileMissingMetadata: This file wasn't exported by the Supertext module, or its header was removed.
messages.supertextFileTooLarge: The file is too large (at most 10 MB).
messages.supertextFileInvalidJob: The file could not be created.
messages.supertextFileOtherSystem: This file belongs to another system ({plugin}).
messages.supertextFileNotFound: The record this file was exported from no longer exists.
messages.supertextFileNotAllowed: You may not edit this record.
messages.supertextFileSourceChanged: Skipped, source changed since the export: {count}
messages.supertextFileIncludeChanged: Also import texts whose source changed since the export
messages.supertextFileHelp: Upload a file exported with Export for translation and translated since. The texts are saved in the record's target language, like a translation with Supertext.
